title.narrative: The UN Global Service Centre (UNGSC) - Technical Support Services for Umoja Infrastructure

description.narrative: Service for Geospatial, Information and Telecommunications Technologies (SGITT) is the operational hub for the support and delivery of ICT services and solutions to field operations and it operates from two locations: The UN Global Service Centre (UNGSC) in Brindisi, Italy, and UNICTFV in Valencia, Spain.\nSGITT supports Peacekeeping operations, Special Political Missions, UN Agencies, Funds and Programmes with round-the-clock, high-availability and resilient information and communications technology, and geospatial information services.\nUNOPS supports the work of the SGITT through specialized expertise capacity.
